label: Change Voice
description: Re-voice a recording: the words, timing, and emotion stay, the voice becomes the one you pick. Audio file in, audio file out.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The ElevenLabs access (wire an ElevenLabsAccess node).

inputs.name: voice
inputs.label: Voice
inputs.placeholder: Pick a voice, or paste a voice id

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.placeholder: Pick a model, or paste its id
inputs.description: ElevenLabs recommends eleven_multilingual_sts_v2 for changing a voice; eleven_english_sts_v2 is English only.

inputs.name: outputFormat
inputs.label: Output format
inputs.description: mp3 or wav for anything that plays a file, pcm, ulaw or alaw for telephony, opus_48000_* for a WhatsApp voice note (stored as Ogg Opus). ElevenLabs gives mp3_44100_192 only on its Creator plan and above, and pcm or wav at 44100 only on Pro and above.

inputs.name: stability
inputs.description: Voice stability (0 varied, 1 monotone). Absent = the voice's own setting.

inputs.name: similarityBoost
inputs.description: How closely the output sticks to the voice. Absent = the voice's own setting.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: Speaking speed multiplier. Absent = the voice's own setting.

inputs.name: style
inputs.description: How much the voice exaggerates its speaker's style: 0 leaves it as it is, and higher values amplify it, which ElevenLabs says can make the answer slower.

inputs.name: speakerBoost
inputs.label: Speaker boost
inputs.description: Makes the audio sound more like the voice's original speaker, at the cost of a slightly slower answer.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: If you want to be able to make a similar take again, set any whole number here, then run again with that number and the same recording. ElevenLabs tries to give the same audio back but does not promise it. Leave empty for a new random seed each run.

inputs.name: fileFormat
inputs.label: Recording format
inputs.description: If the recording is raw 16-bit PCM at 16 kHz, mono, little-endian, pick pcm_s16le_16: ElevenLabs answers sooner than for an encoded file. Leave `other` for anything else.

inputs.name: enableLogging
inputs.label: Keep history
inputs.description: Turn off for zero retention: ElevenLabs then keeps no history of the request. Only Enterprise accounts can turn it off.
